findings.claim: Teradyne 10-K 風險因子：電子、半導體與機器人產業的產品常被技術更先進的替代品取代，舊技術需求下降時售價下滑；若無法推出新技術，營收與財務狀況可能受不利影響。未點名具體替代技術。
findings.excerpt: In the electronics, semiconductor, and robotics industries, products are often replaced by more technologically advanced substitutes and, as demand for older technology falls, the price at which such products can be sold drops. If we cannot advance new technologies to meet our customers’ demands, our revenues and financial condition may be adversely impacted.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋兩次未找到點名取代 ATE 的具體替代技術；來源多為投資評論，傾向系統級測試、矽光子測試等為新增測試層而非取代。

clues.claim: 第三方文章稱傳統 ATE 無法抓到 AI 工作負載所有重要缺陷，催生系統級測試等相鄰測試層；Advantest 與 Teradyne 在高階 ATE 合計約 90% 份額（第三方估計）。
clues.source: Wing VC, The Chip Testing Bottleneck
